before: An agent that proposed a model's paragraph rewrite as tracked changes wrote its own word diff, rollback, and retry over the editing API.
after: proposeRewrite in @docx-editor.dev/editor-api/agent writes the rewrite through the existing tracked text operations, rejects only its own revisions after a failed write, and prepares the paragraph again after another participant's edit.
reason: The helper uses only existing editing API reads and writes, and core caches the field reads of a paragraph by node identity, which an edit replaces. It adds no operation, node kind, shared field, or serialization, so convergence, undo, and reconnect behavior is unchanged. The collaboration test runs a participant's edit between two of the helper's writes and during the model call, and checks that both peers converge with the participant's edit kept.
